label: production-final
method: Terminal uScene/uDepth post-composite draws to the default framebuffer; CPU submission timestamps, not compositor presentation or GPU completion.
caveats: 4x CPU throttling keeps the host desktop GPU; this is a mobile CPU/viewport simulation, not physical mid-range-phone certification.
Counts are actual terminal post-pass draw submissions. They are not raw rAF, compositor presentation, or completed GPU timings.
The steady run follows a first traversal, so downloaded later-room assets and shaders can be warm. The first traversal is reported separately.
No screenshots, CPU sampling profiler, or tracing run during FPS collection. The lightweight GL hooks and one post-draw microtask add small measurement overhead.
buildDetectionCaveat: Only dev-only resource markers count. Their absence does not prove production; Turbopack is also used in production.
